0022600160.text: The Pacers (2-5, 0-3 at home, on a four-game losing streak) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-4, coming off a loss, and 0.5 games behind the Southeast leader) in the Pacers' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with Indiana 3.5 games back in the Central and 12th in the East and Atlanta 7th in the East. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Kingston Flemings (suspension). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost the season series 1-2, though Indiana won the most recent meeting 129-124 in Indianapolis on January 31, 2026.
